title: SOSA/SSN Usage Observatory
description:
An observatory of how the W3C/OGC Semantic Sensor Network ontology (SSN) and its core, SOSA, are used in the scientific literature: every work that cites a publication on SOSA/SSN or writes its names in its full text (3,067 works in this release), with how it uses SOSA/SSN (engagement, version, modules, terms, results and values, errors, domain, companion vocabularies, published artefacts, reported gaps, modelling patterns), coded by language models, agents and scripts.

The release holds the knowledge graph (Turtle; FaBiO, CiTO, MOD, DCAT, PROV-O), the data of the web application (https://ci.mines-stetienne.fr/sosa-ssn-observatory/), the harvests, codes and figures it is built from, and the code to rebuild it. No full text and no quotation of the works are included.

OpenAlex records are CC0; data of the works known only to Semantic Scholar are from the Semantic Scholar Academic Graph (ODC-BY).
